instructions.mission: Create comprehensive story context for Epic {epic_num} Story {story_num}

steps.step: Identify the target story from the epic documentation. Epic: {epic_num}, Story: {story_num}
Load and analyze: - Epic definition and story requirements - PRD for product context - Architecture document for technical constraints
Identify relevant architectural patterns, file locations, and technical constraints that the developer agent will need.

Create a comprehensive story file with: - User story statement (As a... I want... So that...) - Acceptance criteria with checkboxes - Tasks and subtasks - Developer notes with architecture patterns - File locations and dependencies
Save the story file to the implementation artifacts directory. Ensure all acceptance criteria are specific and testable.
